name: Australian Coastal Safaris
summary: Australian Coastal Safaris runs small-group guided tours from Port Lincoln on the Eyre Peninsula, using 4WD vehicles and local guides. Nearly all tours take between two and six guests. The coastal days include a beach seafood gathering experience and a Coffin Bay day with oysters, a smokehouse and a tuna boat or marina cruise.
standouts: Certified as a Sustainable Tourism Accredited Business
Member of Australian Wildlife Journeys, a Tourism Australia Signature Experience
Member of Great Fishing Adventures of Australia, a Signature Experience of Australia
Guides were born or grew up on the Eyre Peninsula

trips.title: Hunt and Gather Seafood Experience
trips.summary: A full day of hands-on seafood gathering on the Eyre Peninsula coast with an Australian Coastal Safaris guide. Guests forage for cockles, fish for Australian salmon from a beach and watch the guide dive for abalone close to shore. The day also takes in a 4WD drive over large sand dunes and a seafood lunch prepared on the beach.
highlights: Forage for cockles in the sand
Surf fishing for Australian salmon from a beach
The guide dives for abalone close to shore
4WD drive over large sand dunes and a seafood lunch prepared on the beach

trips.title: Coffin Bay Wild Coast & Seafood Experience
trips.summary: A full day from Port Lincoln to Coffin Bay with an Australian Coastal Safaris guide. Guests collect and shuck oysters, walk Coffin Bay National Park, taste small-batch smoked Bluefin Tuna and Kingfish at a family-run smokehouse and share a seafood cook-up. The afternoon is either a cruise through the Port Lincoln marina on a canal cruiser or a visit aboard a heritage tuna boat, depending on availability.
highlights: Collect oysters at the source and learn to shuck them
Smoked Bluefin Tuna and Kingfish tastings at a family-run smokehouse
Afternoon marina cruise or heritage tuna boat experience, depending on availability

checkNotes: Scope: only two trips are listed, the ones Australian Coastal Safaris guides itself and the site describes with an on-water or shoreline part and a Rezdy link. Rezdy account australiancoastalsafaris is the operator's own (the site loads its plugin script from that account); no rezdy.com page was opened. Booking links are the per-tour 'Book this Tour' links on the tour pages and end in ?iframe=true. LEFT OUT because the marine part is run by an outside operator: (1) the shark cage dive and sea lion swim packages Great White Sharks & Exceptional Port Lincoln Adventure (2 days 2 nights, from $1600, Rezdy 457963), Port Lincoln Underwater Weekend Adventure (from $1615, Rezdy 479588) and Great White Sharks & Coffin Bay (from $1660, Rezdy 741284), shown at /tours/port-lincoln-underwater-weekend-adventure/ and with identical content at /tours/great-white-shark-adventures/. The booking terms say outside operators run shark cage diving and sea lion swims and that their cancellation rules apply; the tour page names Calypso as the dive operator and a photo on the sea creatures page is credited to Calypso Star Charters. (2) Hook & Sinker Fishing Safari (3 days 2 nights from $2050, or 4 days 3 nights January to May from $2880, enquiry only), because the FAQ says the fishing charter operator is a partner. (3) Wildlife & Ocean Encounter (3 days 3 nights, price on request, enquiry only, Baird Bay sea lion and dolphin swim; the commitments page lists Baird Bay Eco Tours as a partner) and Winter Whale Watching & Wildlife Encounter (4 days 4 nights, July to September, price 'Please Contact Us', Fowlers Bay whale cruise, Rezdy 439902; the page also carries a stray link to tour 67159, which belongs to another tour). A person may want to add (1) to (3) as operator-sold packages. LEFT OUT as land-only: Exceptional Port Lincoln, Seafood & Wildlife (from $310), Coffin Bay Oysters, Ocean & Nature (from $340), Epicurean Safari (from $385), Port Lincoln Wildlife Encounters, Port Lincoln and Coffin Bay Highlights, the two cruise ship on-shore tours, Bird Watching, Electric Mountain Bikes and the South Point Beach House stay. Prices: tour pages show only 'From $x' with no unit. The FAQ says children aged 4 to 15 pay a child rate and under 4 are free, with no child amounts shown. The booking terms say rates are valid from 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027, prices include GST, a deposit is required, card fees apply, and surcharges may apply on block-out dates, weekends and school holidays (no amounts). The block-out dates on that page are for 2025 and early 2026, so they look out of date. Contact: the email was hidden by the site's email protection and was decoded from the page's own link; the phone shows as 0472 682 490 and +61 4 7268 2490; only the town and postcode are given, no street address. The site also says it started in 2005 as Goin' Off Safaris and that the company operates under Goin' Off Safaris Pty Ltd. Sighting claims on the site (dolphins, sea lions, sharks) are not repeated.
